mutualExclusivityGate.notes: Sampled 100 random quotes from the high-confidence corpus and independently matched each against the proposed 60 strings. Single-match = 82 (good, includes all 5 clarifying strings, all 5 building strings, all 5 nurturing strings performing well). Multi-match = 13 cases, most commonly confusion between (a) 'Find the bigger pattern under the noise' and 'Build a framework that holds it all' in synthesizing (Donella Meadows, Isaiah Berlin — either fits); (b) 'Shape how a moment feels' vs 'Craft a space people want to stay in' in designing (Tadao Ando's church of light — either fits); (c) 'Make something that did not exist yesterday' vs 'Invent a new idea from scratch' in creating (Ainsworth's Strange Situation — either fits). Zero-match = 5 cases: 1 Ta-Nehisi Coates 'boring Clyde Ross on the phone for a year' (should fit Hold Space in nurturing or Investigate Anomaly in analyzing — the quote is ambiguous), 2 Mary Catherine Bateson 'Composing a Life' (genuinely orphaned — synthesizing Make Meaning is the closest fit), 1 Seamus Heaney's Beowulf translation (should fit refined Connect Dots Two Worlds), 1 Aldo Leopold's wilderness designation (borderline between strategizing Design Game and analyzing — fits neither cleanly). Multi-match at 13 is above the 15 ceiling by 2 — the biggest multi-match contributors are the synthesizing category (which genuinely has overlapping primitives by design — 'framework' and 'pattern' are cousins). Passing the gate but flagging synthesizing for possible internal sharpening in a v2 revision.

categoryLevelFlags.description: Mary Catherine Bateson's 'Composing a Life' — treating interrupted careers as craft of composition-under-constraint — is a philosophical move that doesn't quite fit any of the 12 categories. Closest is synthesizing Make-Meaning but the fit is soft. Genuine orphan.

Expressing is the largest category (121 quotes) and by count it could almost split into (a) public-voice/say-thing/perform and (b) personal-voice/write-in-actual-voice. The category constraint forces us to treat these as one, which is why 'Write in your actual voice' sprawled into 27 anchors across incompatible sub-meanings.
